name: SkyBreathe
summary: Fuel efficiency software using physics and AI on flight data to find fuel savings, with an AI assistant; used by 80+ airlines and selected by IAG in 2026.
paragraphs: Fuel efficiency software using physics and AI on flight data to find fuel savings, with an AI assistant; used by 80+ airlines and selected by IAG in 2026.
whyItMatters: Fuel is a top airline cost, and the vendor claims savings of up to 5%.
